title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
description:
S01 E04 — Andrew Jackson and the War of 1812
Why the United States chooses to fight Britain in the War of 1812; America's grievances and ambitions, which include the conquest of Canada; the poor strategy, command and training that lead to a strategic stalemate; the exception is Andrew Jackson.

title: The US Constitution through History
description:
S01 E01 — America's Founding Ideas
Start the course on the U.S. Constitution by learning about the English culture that inspired American law and the conflict with England that caused the revolution.

title: The US Constitution through History
description:
S01 E02 — Failures of Early American Governments
Consider where the Articles of Confederation came from.

title: The US Constitution through History
description:
S01 E03 — Dilemmas of the Constitutional Convention
Witness the heated discussions surrounding the establishment of a new form of national governance.

title: The US Constitution through History
description:
S01 E04 — The Ratification of the Constitution
Reach back to the end of the eighteenth century and explore the attitudes of the various states towards the establishment of a unified federal government.

title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History
description:
S01 E05 — Emancipation and the Civil War
Studying relics and documents related to the emancipation of slaves during the Civil War era; General Lee's surrender at Appomattox; poignant stories told by artifacts from the Smithsonian's National Museum of African American History and Culture.

title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History
description:
S01 E06 — Gold, Guns, and Grandeur - The West
The tale told by a tiny gold flake, which launches the California Gold Rush in the late 1840s. The Colt revolver has a profound impact; the West through the eyes of both settlers and natives in Albert Bierstadt's art; Sitting Bull's drawing book.

title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History
description:
S01 E07 — The First Americans - Then and Now
Stone points produced at the end of the last ice age by the Clovis culture of early hunter-gatherers in the Americas; the mystery of the birdman carving found in an ancient Native American burial mound; tribal traditions inspire Indian artists.

title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History
description:
S01 E08 — Planes, Trains, Automobiles ... and Wagons
Four key artifacts that tell the story of America on the move; the Conestoga wagon; the John Bull steam locomotive; the Ford Model T; Charles Lindbergh's airplane, the Spirit of St. Louis; each represents a technology that alters the nation.

title: America's Founding Fathers
description:
S01 E01 — George Washington's Doubts
Explaining the importance of getting a well-rounded understanding of the Founders; Professor Guelzo explores Washington's fears about post-Revolutionary America; Washington's concerns about how people could administer their own affairs.

title: America's Founding Fathers
description:
S01 E02 — Thomas Mifflin's Congress
Before the ratification of the Constitution, there are presidents of the Congress created by the Articles of Confederation; the failures of one president, Thomas Mifflin, offer a window into the problems facing the United States of America in 1783.

title: America's Founding Fathers
description:
S01 E03 — Robert Morris's Money
Money issues abound in the new United States; why the abundance of land is a problem; what compels states to print their own paper money; how Robert Morris attempts to restore the links between commerce, agriculture and government finances.

title: America's Founding Fathers
description:
S01 E04 — Benjamin Franklin's Leather Apron
Exploring the many roles Benjamin Franklin plays in the formative years of the republic; this includes his part as an independent printer, a public "gentleman", a nobleman of nature and a tradesman cynical of the wealthy and powerful.

title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
description:
S01 E01 — America: Forged in War
Exploring The French and Indian War of the mid-1700s, which is one of the formative conflicts in American military history; focusing on the experiences of Lt. Col. George Washington, a young colonial officer fighting for the British.

title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
description:
S01 E02 — George Washington Takes Command
When the colonies begin their struggle for independence, they choose George Washington to lead the army; Washington's defense of Boston; his defeat trying to hold New York City; contrasting British and American objectives in the Revolutionary War.

title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
description:
S01 E03 — Redcoats Fall to the Continental Army
Washington's army is in dire straits; his command is in question; he revives his reputation with the famous crossing of the Delaware River; the next four years of the American Revolution, which see Britain's strategic advantage deteriorate.

title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe
description:
S01 E01 — The Medieval City - A Feast for the Senses
The sights and smells of the medieval city; exploring the rich details of markets, monasteries, churches and religious and civic events; life in the townhouses of the rich, the tenements of the poor; the activities of medieval societies.

title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe
description:
S01 E02 — Rothenburg - Jewel On the Romantic Road
A well-preserved German medieval city; exploring the imposing mansions of the city's former elite, the grand fountains and the market square with its remarkable gothic town Hall; visiting St. Jakob's Church; walking the bastions of the city walls.

title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe
description:
S01 E03 — Mdina - The Silent City
Malta's Mdina through the history of the Knights of Malta, who ruled the island for nearly 300 years; the great palaces of the nobility and their Gothic and classical architecture; the city's medieval atmosphere in the winding Moorish streets.

title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe
description:
S01 E04 — Mdina and Rabat - In the Steps of St. Paul
The Roman history of Malta and St. Paul's internment on the island; in Rabat, experiencing key sites such as the splendid Roman villa, the Grotto of St. Paul and the catacombs where Christians seek refuge; the events of the Great Siege of 1565.

title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
description:
S01 E01 — Touring the Cradle of Western Civilization
The dynamic civilizations that emerge in the Aegean; the scope of the human drama that is played out there; some of the towering figures and remarkable sites to encounter; Professor Hale's recommendations for traveling this world as the ancients did.

title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
description:
S01 E02 — Athens - Around the Acropolis and Parthenon
The Acropolis is a symbol of Athens; the path of the ancient annual procession honoring Athena; the history and meanings of the site's iconic buildings; the superlative architectural features of the Parthenon and its surprising original uses.

title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
description:
S01 E03 — In the Footsteps of Socrates - Historic Athens
Treasures surrounding the Acropolis; the Theater of Dionysos, where one ponders the rituals of early dramatic festivals; the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, a venue of music and recitations; the Pnyx, an ancient hilltop assembly point; the agora market.

title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
description:
S01 E04 — Around Attica - Temples and Mysteries
Visiting sacred monuments of Greece's beautiful Attica region; the Amphiareion is a shrine of a prophet deity; ancient oracle and healing practices; imposing shrines to Artemis and Poseidon; Eleusis is the site of mystical religious rituals.

title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages
description:
S01 E01 — Point Zéro: Charting Our Course
Contemplating the French art de vivre and the appeal that makes France one of the most visited tourist spots; an overview of the upcoming journey across the rich cultural landscape of France; learning about the iconic figure of Charles de Gaulle.

title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages
description:
S01 E02 — The Birth and Rise of Paris
Learning how Paris evolves from an ancient settlement to a Roman city and then the capital; studying medieval Paris through the Cluny Museum, the great cathedral of Notre Dame and the royal chapel of Sainte-Chapelle; following the growth of Paris.

title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages
description:
S01 E03 — The Splendor of Versailles
Discovering the Palace of Versailles as the world of Louis XIV; noting how the landscaping surrounding the palace symbolizes features of Louis's reign and how the Versailles court prizes royal spectacle; exploring Louis's patronage of the arts.

title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages
description:
S01 E04 — Paris in Revolution
Examining the social and political background of the French Revolution of 1789; visiting key locations in Paris where the events unfold, from a coffee house to the site of the Bastille prison and the Place de la Concorde; mapping Napoleon's rise.

title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C.
description:
S01 E01 — How Washington DC Came to Be
Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall.

title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C.
description:
S01 E02 — The White House and the Presidency
Tracking the history and fortunes of the White House; visiting the White House, beginning with the Oval Office and Cabinet Room; visiting the parks adjoining the White House; the Jefferson and Franklin Delano Roosevelt memorials.

title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C.
description:
S01 E03 — The Capitol Building and the Legislature
How the Capitol building is designed, constructed and expanded in the early years of the nation; touring the architectural and artistic wonders of the building; concluding with the House and Senate Chambers; the surrounding parks and gardens.

title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C.
description:
S01 E04 — The Supreme Court and the Law of the Land
Studying the founding and history of the Supreme Court; touring this structure, its interior features, court facilities and artistic decoration; exploring the Court in action, which encompasses courtroom procedure and how cases are processed.
